entities.name: Roman Saturnalia Festival
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: A week-long December festival where social rules were inverted: masters served slaves, gambling was permitted, gifts were exchanged, and candles lit the long nights. Public business halted and schools closed. The Christian church later absorbed Saturnalia's customs into Christmas.
